items.title: Awesome Rtc Updates on Mar 28 - Apr 03, 2022
items.summary: 10 awesome projects updated on Mar 28 - Apr 03, 2022
items.content_text:
### Server Software / Media Servers

*   [Jitsi](https://jitsi.org/projects) - A collection of RTC open source projects, with a focus on conferencing software.

### Operations / Testing

*   [sipexer (⭐436)](https://github.com/miconda/sipexer) - Modern and flexible SIP command line tool.

### Operations / Web/API Interfaces

*   [Eqivo](https://eqivo.org) - Open source programmable-voice/telephony API platform.
*   [Fonoster (⭐8.2k)](https://github.com/fonoster/fonoster) - Open source platform for programmable voice and voice AI applications.
*   [Wazo](https://wazo-platform.org) - VoIP API platform built on top of Asterisk, Kamailio and RTPEngine.
*   [jambonz](https://www.jambonz.org) - Open source CPaaS built for communications service providers.
*   [IVOZ Provider (⭐228)](https://github.com/irontec/ivozprovider) - Multitenant solution for VoIP telephony providers.

### Developer Resources / C/C++ Libraries

*   [Sofia-SIP (⭐358)](https://github.com/freeswitch/sofia-sip) - Open source SIP library used by FreeSWITCH.

### Events and Talks / Media over QUIC

*   [FOSDEM](https://fosdem.org) - Free event for software developers, with a RTC component, held every year in Europe.

### Related Lists / Media over QUIC

*   [SIP Resources (⭐260)](https://github.com/miconda/sip-resources) - Useful SIP resources curated by Kamailio's head developer.

items.title: Awesome Rtc Updates on Nov 25 - Dec 01, 2019
items.summary: 31 awesome projects updated on Nov 25 - Dec 01, 2019
items.content_text:
### Server Software / SIP Servers

*   [Routr](https://routr.io) - Cloud-native SIP proxy, registrar and location service.
*   [Sippy B2BUA (⭐203)](https://github.com/sippy/b2bua) - Back-to-back user agent server written in Python.

### Server Software / Media Servers

*   [Janus](https://janus.conf.meetecho.com) - Lightweight open source, general purpose, WebRTC gateway.
*   [RTPProxy](https://www.rtpproxy.org) - General purpose high performance RTP proxy.
*   [mediasoup](https://mediasoup.org) - Specialized WebRTC conferencing system.
*   [SEMS (⭐189)](https://github.com/sems-server/sems) - Open source media and application server for SIP based VoIP services.

### Server Software / STUN/TURN

*   [coturn (⭐15k)](https://github.com/coturn/coturn) - Fully featured TURN/STUN server supporting multiple platforms.
*   [STUNTMAN (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/jselbie/stunserver) - RFC compliant open source STUN implementation.

### Operations / Monitoring

*   [sngrep (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/irontec/sngrep) - Terminal based SIP flow viewer.
*   [sipgrep (⭐180)](https://github.com/sipcapture/sipgrep) - Console tool for sniffing, capturing and exploring SIP traffic.
*   [HOMER (⭐2k)](https://github.com/sipcapture/homer) - Multi-protocol capturing and monitoring framework for RTC.
*   [Trickle ICE](https://webrtc.github.io/samples/src/content/peerconnection/trickle-ice) - Exposes client-side NAT traversal debug data.

### Operations / Testing

*   [SIPVicious (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/EnableSecurity/sipvicious) - Suite of security tools that can be used to audit SIP based VoIP systems.
*   [sipsak (⭐177)](https://github.com/nils-ohlmeier/sipsak) - SIP stress and diagnostics utility.

### Operations / Web/API Interfaces

*   [FusionPBX](https://www.fusionpbx.com) - Multitenant system built on top of FreeSWITCH.
*   [FreePBX](https://www.freepbx.org) - Web Manager for Asterisk.

### Developer Resources / Tutorials

*   [WebRTC Samples](https://webrtc.github.io/samples) - Collection of samples demonstrating various parts of the WebRTC APIs.

### Developer Resources / JavaScript Libraries

*   [drachtio](https://drachtio.org) - Node.js SIP server framework.
*   [adapter.js (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/webrtcHacks/adapter) - JavaScript shim for abstracting WebRTC spec changes and inconsistencies.
*   [simple-peer (⭐7.8k)](https://github.com/feross/simple-peer) - WebRTC wrapper for browser media streams and data channels.

### Developer Resources / C/C++ Libraries

*   [PJSIP](https://www.pjsip.org) - Multi-protocol RTC library written in C.
*   [eXosip](http://savannah.nongnu.org/projects/exosip) - eXtended osip is a mature C library for abstracting the SIP protocol.
*   [libdatachannel (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/paullouisageneau/libdatachannel) - Standalone C/C++ library for WebRTC data channels, media transport and WebSockets.
*   [libSRTP (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/cisco/libsrtp) - Secure Real-time Transport Protocol (SRTP) library for C.
*   [usrsctp (⭐765)](https://github.com/sctplab/usrsctp) - Portable Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP) user-land stack.

### Developer Resources / Go Libraries

*   [Pion](https://pion.ly) - Extensive software stack for WebRTC written in Go.
*   [go-diameter (⭐298)](https://github.com/fiorix/go-diameter) - RFC compliant Diameter protocol library.

### Developer Resources / Python Libraries

*   [aiortc (⭐5.1k)](https://github.com/aiortc/aiortc) - WebRTC and ORTC implementation for Python using asyncio.

### Developer Resources / Erlang Libraries

*   [ersip (⭐130)](https://github.com/poroh/ersip) - Library comprising building blocks for SIP applications.

### Blogs / Media over QUIC

*   [BlogGeekMe](https://bloggeek.me/blog) - Blog by Tsahi Levent-Levi with a strong focus on WebRTC.
*   [WebRTCHacks](https://webrtchacks.com) - WebRTC blog by independent technologists.
